notes.title: Version 4.01
notes.notes: Changes for turn based mode beta.  Consult AQR Discord server for details.

notes.title: Version 4.00 - The Fourth Star Achievement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/60a3d65f79a1c201ae26bab83b37f67f45df70dc.png[/img]The new achievement signaling that you are a Champion of the city triggers at AQR 14229.  If you already have that score on the leaderboard you might automatically be granted the achievement.

Some world cultures do not like the number four.  Some do not like thirteen.   Other numbers hold superstitions to other people.  Those who do not like the number four will want to exit their games before achieving the AQR score of 14229.

notes.title: Version 3.35 - Cleanup St Louis
notes.notes: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/b2478aac4fb0ac30427e707bada14edf7b09f2d9.png[/img]St Louis now looks new and spiffy like most other cities in All Quiet Roads.   The background artwork is inspired by the topography of the St Louis area.

notes.title: Version 3.34 - Restore scores from achievement and leaderboard data
notes.notes: Version 3.33 was unfortunate, and wiped a lot of people's local data.   Version 3.34 should restore unlocked cities and the stars achieved.   However, it is unlikely to preserve your saved games.  I am very sorry about that.

notes.title: Version 3.33 - behind the scenes changes for Turn Based
notes.notes: Hopefully nothing in this version changes gameplay in the Classic version of AQR.   One notable change is that roads turning red are timed more accurately by the game elapsed clock rather than the real time clock.

notes.title: Version 3.21 - Tokyo map fixes
notes.notes:
This patch fixes several problems in the Tokyo map, especially in the area around the Tokyo Skytree landmark.
[list]
[*] Improve the shape of the waterway immediately to the NorthWest of the Skytree.
[*] Move the Skytree a little ways eastward.
[*] Improve the construction of bridges above the Skytree (they sometimes started on land)
[*] Fix several visual holes in the Tokyo map.
[*] Repair two islands in the Northwest of Tokyo Bay, and one island in the Northeast of Tokyo Bay so that the construction grid appears overtop of the island.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 3.17 - Fix the screen resolution progressively shrinking bug.
notes.notes:
This version corrects the screen resolution.

In a recent patch to try and keep the game on the correct monitor an old bug was reintroduced where switching between windowed and fullscreen resulted in a loss of resolution.   Continuing to switch would make the windowed mode smaller and smaller while fullscreen became more pixelated.  While version 3.17 fixes this bug there may (again) be an issue with finding the correct monitor.

notes.title: Version 3.16 - No auto scaling of zoomed cameras
notes.notes: A zoomed-in camera no longer automatically gets larger as the map grows.  Zoomed cameras now only move under player control.

notes.title: Version 3.15 - Bug fix for level saving
notes.notes:
Some Turn Based code was accidentally partially enabled and it caused game saves to fail.

Turn Based testing should start (via Discord) in about a week.   Check the Discord forum for details of how to enable Turn Based when those details become available.  The full release of Turn Based is expected in early October.

notes.title: Version 3.14 - Increased Font Support
notes.notes: Some names in the leaderboards looked like □□□□.  Most names now look good.

notes.title: Version 3.13 - Housing Acts Normal (again)
notes.notes: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/dd1a1c73e15be11eaae596c28cdd23d686b08aaf.png[/img]The residents of the housing neighborhoods spoke up and they still want vehicles to travel through the neighborhood.   The prior patch has been reverted in the interest of a more playable (and fun) game.  Housing neighborhoods function as they did previously

notes.title: Version 3.12 - No Housing Thru-Traffic
notes.notes: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/b8839b5410074c9611b73740830ffa66236844d3.png[/img]Circle shaped housing neighborhoods now only allow circle shaped vehicles to enter.  Other vehicles may not pass through housing neighborhoods.

notes.title: Version 3.07 - Minor Improvements to Main Menu
notes.notes: Make the main menu feel a tiny bit more polished.

notes.title: Version 3.06 - Wrong Way Collisions changed
notes.notes: Going the wrong way on a one way road will still consume a tow truck to remove the vehicle.  However, when there are no more tow trucks available the vehicle will instead get stuck, and might be removed after a period of time if it cannot unstick from its wrong-way position.

notes.title: Version 3.05 - Name Change
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/5058c94ed89b9dc9266ab69ecb8e2204076cc553.png[/img]Shhhh!! Don't say 4743.  The game is now known as All Quiet Roads.   The shortened name is designed to make the game more attractive to new players.  The logo is also changing to just AQR.

4743 continues being the minimum score for the third Achievement in each city, and the minimum score necessary to be listed on the leaderboard.

notes.title: Version 3.04 - Rio de Janeiro background update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/740410beb275c1f4c2719134856ef49e8421b483.png[/img]The background artwork for Rio de Janeiro is updated to look similar to the other refurbished cities.

There are still some places where vehicles awkwardly drive under the near side of hills.  This will be fixed in future patches.

notes.title: Version 3.03 - One Way Road Patch
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/c58fd3e63f823908d8683ee9a92933e77e1425ce.png[/img]One way streets no longer slow down when entering and leaving neighborhoods.

This patch also repairs,
[list]
[*] Fills holes that were in the Paris map.
[*] Allows one way roads to maintain speed when crossing a simple road on an overpass.
[*] Increases the button size for bulk erasure options. (making them readable!)
[*] Bulk erasing roads does not prematurely disconnect roads from neighborhoods.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 3.01 - Minor Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Repaired three minor bugs:
[olist]
[*] Vehicles no longer avoid a very specific small number of bridges made in a prior session of the game.
[*] The Fast Forward effect should now always end at 500.
[*] Attempting to show neighborhood governance right as a reward decision appears does not freeze the game.
[/olist]

notes.title: Version 3.0 - Tokyo!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/b6c7d5eefe0407d950fb3b3b94a26a2804b7a466.png[/img]Version 3 has a variety of changes in addition to adding Tokyo as a playable city.

Version 3 changes include:
[list]
[*] Added Tokyo!
[*] More information in leaderboard.
[*] Three new Settings options:
[olist]
[*] Option to disable automatically selecting the next available road type.
[*] Option to automatically put barricades on new neighborhoods.
[*] Option to automatically put up No Thru Traffic signs on new neighborhoods.
[/olist]
[*] Circular danger indicator around red neighborhoods.
[*] Numerous minor bug fixes.
[/list]

Enjoy playing version 3! 

...development continues...

notes.title: Version 2.37 - Minor Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/1254caedc6cf23bf200d07f0ed200843ae38000e.png[/img]The fanciest tasks in castle spires,
Are the loneliness dreamt in green fields
Where iconoclastic creative desires
Are blunted by massive shields.
Alone at court is the typical fate
For nobles with some fatigue         
Or, those who choose to shun the state
And yield to court intrigue.
To venture afield without a king
Is like an hourglass low on sand
The joy of lightness is ex-cit-ing
Until the food is out of hand.
My wish is still to explore some more,
Because so much is left to do.
But though this love was not a chore,
Soon I must say ado.


Another city was in development and I hope to finish it off in the coming days.  Thank you to RCE for the video he made.   It gave me hope.   I've been unsuccessful at enticing any other major influencers to make a video.   Hopefully, some day, someone will reveal the explanatory "easter egg" in the game.

notes.title: Version 2.36 - Smaller Memory Footprint
notes.notes: Several memory management changes have been made to allow AQR4743 to run on a broader range of hardware.  The downside of this current version is a noticeable pause when entering a city map.  In time, this pause will get covered by a loading progress bar so that the game doesn't look frozen.

notes.title: Version 2.35 - Two One Ways Become One Freeway
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/6deb896522c6f97ca1fca194369635f49f5b31ea.png[/img]One way roads work much as they did previously except that now vehicles travel along one-way roads at freeway speeds!  Additionally, if you try to change the direction of a one-way road without first erasing the road it will transform the road into a freeway.

If you really want to change the direction of a one-way road, then erase the old road first.  Build the new road in the opposite direction after the old one-way road is gone.

Many of the city item exchanges are updated to convert freeway tiles into two one-way tiles.   That new exchange allows you to get back any one-way tiles consumed by conversion to freeways.

notes.title: Version 2.34 - Bug fixes and minor features
notes.notes: Fixed a number of small bugs, including the progress markers sometimes appearing squished.  Also added a tooltip for barricades so that it is a little more obvious what they do.

notes.title: Version 2.33 - No Erratic Highway Speeds
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/377c85e2d851d62d8cf007eb49e9b7566af41221.png[/img]This fixes a long standing bug where vehicles experienced seemingly random road speeds.

Sometimes the speed of a previous road that was erased and replaced affected the speed of the new road.   While I'm sure that this bug allowed for some lovely exploits those exploits are now over.   Roads, Freeways, and One Ways all act at their intended speed limits.

It's highly likely that one-way roads will be increasing to freeway speeds in an upcoming release.

notes.title: Version 2.31 - Detached Neighborhoods Are Less Bossy
notes.notes: The new visual that warns of neighborhoods with no roads was spamming the display far too often.  Now, it notifies once, and each additional notification for the same neighborhood is delayed by an increasing amount of time.   It still pesters the player, but hopefully it is less annoying.

notes.title: Version 2.30 - New Look For Paris
notes.notes: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/95e441685fb101a8f3742d784b83876efe7f27d3.png[/img]Paris was updated to a topography based color scheme similar to New York and London.

notes.title: Version 2.29 - Extra Warnings for New Neighborhoods
notes.notes:
The settings panel now has a checkbox for highlighting any neighborhood that is not connected to any roadway.  This usually happens when a neighborhood is new, and you just haven't noticed it on the map.  By default, the checkbox is turned on, so if you like this option there is nothing that you need to adjust.

If a neighborhood is on the map but it doesn't have any roads connected to it then periodically it will display a conspicuous warning from your current camera position to the direction of the new neighborhood.   This should help a lot in finding new neighborhoods that spawned without being noticed.

notes.title: Version 2.28
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/d78e82d329922d4a4a2bb9bdbf1ff17e40cfcbd2.png[/img]Sometimes you start erasing roads and wonder why they cannot all be erased with the click of a button.  Now, they can.   To use the "Big Pink Eraser" do the following:

[list]
[*] pause the game.
[*] start erasing normally for a couple of seconds.
[*] buttons will appear next to the road inventory.
[*] click the buttons to erase roads in bulk.
[/list]

You still will have to wait for any roads that vehicles are expecting to complete their current trips, but the roads will instantly turn grey as though you had run the eraser over all of them.  Any roads that are not currently expecting vehicles will instantly be removed.

notes.title: Version 2.27 - Fast Forward
notes.notes: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/bd2273e2bf3fdc53e58cb2985c32b5321e2989b9.png[/img]Fast forward is offered until the raw score reaches 500 vehicles.  With fast forward you can move swiftly beyond the early part of the game and get to the real challenge of traffic management.  Fast Forward is fantastic!  Thanks to everyone who suggested this feature.

notes.title: Version 2.26 - Game Saving Bug Fix
notes.notes: Fixed saved games so that upon restoring vehicles do not jump across neighborhoods without traveling smoothly across them.

notes.title: Version 2.25 - New York Background Artwork
notes.notes: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/f995010a58ea1c0b3054e46fe367b32ca6933790.png[/img]The new look for London seemed pretty solid.  This update reinterprets the decisions for London into a color palette for New York.  This art feels like more solid than the original version of New York.

notes.title: Version 2.24 - London Background Artwork
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/172c92720460057e4e23d4845785552988942896.png[/img]This experiment changes out the background artwork in the London map.   The shapes roughly approximate the topography of London.

Is it a better look?   Probably.

Is it the final look?  Maybe not.

notes.title: Version 2.23 - Bridge Price Adjustment
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/fb1d850328145a189e06f7a1befc8d532d84f3d5.png[/img]
Bridge pricing has changed.   Previously, a bridge that would cost 3 now only costs 2.   This was to correct a bug demonstrated by Drawing Dead's YouTube channel.

Bridges had been priced based on the number of tiles the bridge touched.   Now they are priced by the number of steps, which is one less than the number of tiles.  Previously, having one bridge unit left over was essentially useless, as the minimum cost for any bridge was 2.   Now, the minimum cost for a bridge is 1.

This pricing change also solves a bug where bridges disappeared, never to be seen again.   When a player tried to build a bridge but only had one bridge unit remaining in their inventory that single bridge was permanently discarded.    If you ever had the feeling that you had lost bridge tiles, this was probably the reason.

notes.title: Version 2.21 - The Full Leaderboard
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/c68226d4c2d8425391b5442666d831960ffb00bf.png[/img]
The full leaderboard is available by pressing the leaderboard button at the bottom of the selective leaderboard on the city page.   There isn't a lot of functionality to the leaderboard just yet, but it does let you see all of the leaders!   How far are you from first place?

notes.title: Version 2.20 - Smaller Inventory Icons
notes.notes:
The screen size of the inventory icon is reduced.  Their very large size was often seen as aesthetically displeasing.   With the new smaller size they will eventually need hover-over tooltips.  In the meantime, consult the glossary to know what the icons describe.

Also, added item exchange options in New York to get trade in of all the overpasses and one way roads for things more useful to the city.  Enjoy!

notes.title: Version 2.19 - A Fair Exchange
notes.notes: The various exploits in the Item Exchange have been fixed.  Now, cyclical trading cannot increase your inventory.

notes.title: Version 2.18 - New Progress Bar
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/8d1e4c44befccb59d35aa5aa1385e0ee66907a86.png[/img]
In this release of AQR4743:
[list]
[*] Better looking progress bar.  Better than ugly!
[*] Settings option to always show the mini-map.
[*] Escape key can be used to dismiss the Item Exchange.
[*] The tilde and escape keys still work to zoom in and out to your favored distance.
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Version 2.17 - Patched Memory Leaks
notes.notes: This is a first pass at patching some very small but frequent memory leaks.  Another iteration on this will be necessary in the upcoming days to truly fix the leaks.

notes.title: Version 2.16 - Interchanges Unclogged
notes.notes: The cloverleaf icon is currently used to indicate a non-blocking interchange.   Unfortunately, it was not always functioning as expected.   This bug fix allows vehicles passing through a "cloverleaf intersection" to go over each other without blocking.

notes.title: Version 2.15 - Works with Apple Silicon
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/d18118faccdd3c96b8ee90d0bd3962e35405a710.png[/img]All Quiet Roads 4743 should now work with Apple Silicon.

Quite soon, AQR4743 will also work as an offline Steam game.  Offline play will be useful to play in-flight or in remote locations.   Of course, offline play will not support cloud saves nor leaderboards.

notes.title: Version 2.13 - Final Decisions
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/8adacb0cda6f5c436d03eaaffbf4316c1dee65e6.png[/img]
Have you ever wished that the Item Exchange button didn't disappear when the reward decisions are up?  Well, now you can mark your decision as final, and get back to being able to press the Item Exchange or Neighborhood Adjust buttons.   You won't get your reward any faster, but you do get to press the buttons that would otherwise be hidden!

notes.title: Version 2.12 - Neighborhoods Where You Can See Them
notes.notes: This patch fixes the bug where very occasionally neighborhoods appeared offscreen, or partially offscreen.  This occurred more frequently when reloading saved games.

notes.title: Version 2.11 - Performance Improvements
notes.notes: Some big changes to data structures used to manage road connections that should produce performance improvements.

notes.title: Version 2.10 - Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Bug fixes include:
[list]
[*] Neighborhood hover info should format to the correct size when starting a new game.
[*] Level locked stop sign on main page shouldn't stretch horizontally to an uncomfortable size.
[*] Scroll wheel after playing a game should have no effect on the menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 2.09 - Neighborhood Governance
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/f0350d4c7441846ea8f0a6402b3e6208ec9a8404.png[/img] A new neighborhood governance button allows control of two aspects of every neighborhood : whether roads auto-connect, and whether thru traffic is encouraged.

When auto connection is barricaded the neighborhood perimeter has a dashed look.  Any roads that pass tangent to the barricaded neighborhood but do not attach are marked with a red dot to show the lack of automatic attachment.  

When neighborhoods are marked to dissuade thru-traffic the neighborhood outline has a thin pulsating light color.  These neighborhoods will still allow vehicles to pass through them, but only when going around would be impossible or a very long trip.

These two new features of All Quiet Roads 4743 should allow much greater high scores to become possible.

notes.title: Version 2.07 - Performance Enhancement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/20f5c92590ef5781397264392afd4951732cc5e7.png[/img]
This patch fixes the stuttering problems that AQR4743 has experienced in recent days.  The game is running more smoothly once again!

notes.title: Version 2.06 - Iconography Update
notes.notes: An update to the in-game icons looking more unified, easier to understand, and a lot more golden.

notes.title: Version 2.05 - Bright Colors
notes.notes: The previous pale color palettes were not winning any beauty contests so this version switches to intense, fully saturated colors.  It's an improved look while leaving room for improvement.

notes.title: Version 2.03 - First Pass Grass
notes.notes: Rough shapes and colors represent a first pass at adding grassy areas to each map.  Eventually this should give the maps more visual appeal.

notes.title: Version 2.02 - Better Bridges
notes.notes: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/ede099cd9fd0787813b47f3c436ca7235f250e0b.png[/img] In the past, many little changes have been made to bridges.  This time the bridge drawing code was rewritten, and seems okay.  The bridges look better, while still leaving room for improvement.

notes.title: Version 2.01 - Bug Fixes
notes.notes: Some minor bug fixes are included.   Also, made the arrow on the one way road animate to make it more visible.

notes.title: Version 2.00 -- One Way Roads and more!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/afb6d8c09fdd24b85883fbb03b3a55bdc69cd8b9.png[/img]This major update will be followed by some smaller changes over the next few days.   One way roads offer a new opportunity for strategy.   Putting them together with roundabouts and overpasses can produce some very complex road networks and your opportunity to shine with good strategy.

The update includes:
[list]
[*] Roads curve more naturally, and taper nicely from one road type to another.
[*] Vehicle pathing through roundabouts is better than before.
[*] The glossary includes some of the recent upgrades.
[*] The tutorial is tighter and teaches the game better.
[*] One way road tiles offer a new strategy to the game.
[*] Cleanup of some small graphics nuances such as water motion.
[*] UI doesn't wobble like it did before.   Entering the game is a clean dissolve.
[*] The exploit of free upgrades when changing road types on bridge-ways is gone.
[*] Some cities have larger item exchange options.
[/list]

I will continue updating the game for the next few weeks.  Perhaps updates will last longer if I can figure out how to market this game.   I am a single mom trying to make a living as a solo game developer with no other means of support.   How can I get people to buy this game? Should the game sales really take off then there  will be updates long into the future.

User control that blocks neighborhoods from auto-connecting to nearby roads is upcoming soon, as well as some fixing some graphics issues in the game and UI.  I believe this game could be beautiful, but beauty takes time.

if this game makes it to the long term than I really hope to add a day-of-the-week challenge.   For example, every Monday there is a random "Mega Monday" map where you have ridiculous amounts of inventory to work with.   These day-of-the-week maps would give me a good testbed for some new ideas including different play styles.   "Turn-based Tuesday" would be a wonderful challenge to implement.

notes.title: Version 1.24 - Bug fixes
notes.notes:
This patch fixes a number of bugs.  Most importantly,
[list]
[*] The road traffic colors remain visible on re-loaded games.
[*] An impassible region on the northern edge of Staten Island in New York now allows roads.
[*] Some visual oddities in the Paris map are repaired.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.23 - The Roundabout
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/4535667130f466b3a6a1819b120e692db2c43b13.png[/img]
The old traffic light wasn't very effective at controlling traffic.  The roundabout replaces the traffic light and provides pretty effective traffic control.  Drag it onto an intersection and give it a try!

notes.title: Version 1.22 - Freeways Don't Slow Down
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/ac6f58ad3c324496dc718c21624527ede936d37c.png[/img]
Whether a freeway crosses another freeway or crosses a simple road the traffic continues at freeway speed limits, not slowing down for the intersecting road.

Also, minor balance changes to New York.

notes.title: Version 1.21 - Easily Upgrade Bridges
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/709c542a42a89d8805233ec2040917d48abb7b39.png[/img]
You can now rebuild the road across an existing bridge without first destroying the bridge.   No more destroying bridges just to upgrade a road to a freeway!  This also applies to tunnels.

notes.title: Version 1.20 - Camera Bug Fixes
notes.notes: Fixed various camera related bugs including one where restoring a saved game results in being zoomed-in too far.   Unfortunately, this does not fix existing saved games.   Also made balance improvements to Rio de Janeiro.

notes.title: Version 1.19 - Bridge & Tunnel Destruction
notes.notes: When bridges and tunnels are destroyed there is now an accompanying effect.

notes.title: Version 1.18
notes.notes: Added road building and destroying sounds as well as effects to make the process of building feel better.

notes.title: Version 1.17 - London Balance
notes.notes: Improvements are made to the London item progression so that the first city is a little easier to master.

notes.title: Version 1.16 - Ferry Good Capacity
notes.notes: Ferries were intended to have capacity corresponding to the length of the ferry route.  This update makes ferry boats and parking lots for longer ferry routes have larger sizes.

notes.title: Version 1.15 - No More Magnifying Glass
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/b2f6077db5621e19989cf851fee2516551e89ccb.jpg[/img]
All Quiet Roads 4743 has stopped using a magnifying glass to zoom.
Zooming into the map is now done traditionally, with the mouse wheel or keyboard, and a mini-map shows the complete map view.

notes.title: Version 1.13, The Glossary
notes.notes: Included a glossary of all the inventory items and how they work.

notes.title: Version 1.11 looks cleaner
notes.notes: Some updates to important visuals to make a cleaner look.

notes.title: Version 1.10 Tow Truck Update
notes.notes:
The tow truck now has buttons to affect an entire fleet of vehicles at a time.   The game must be paused and the Tow Truck construction type must be selected in the inventory.  Three buttons appear which correspond to:

[list]
[*] Towing away all vehicles on red roads.
[*] Towing away all vehicles on red or yellow roads.
[*] Towing away every vehicle currently on a road
[/list]

Buttons are enabled only if you have enough tow trucks available to tow the designated fleet.

notes.title: Bug fix version 1.08
notes.notes: Fixed some visual bugs that do not affect gameplay.

notes.title: Version 1.06, the Overpass Test.
notes.notes: Version 1.06 is a live play test of Overpasses in London.

notes.title: Version 1.03 Has Music
notes.notes: The game again has music!  Good-bye to an "interesting" experiment with procedural music generation.

notes.title: Version 1.01
notes.notes: The tutorial has been improved.

notes.title: Game Release Date
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780755/7418cca2669f89e072adbafc648b1226076d18e3.png[/img]
Several hours before the calendar turns to April 12th All Quiet Roads 4743 will launch!

Alpha testers are having fun.  They say that playing through the game is captivating, even addictive.  However, getting onto the leaderboards with scores of AQR 4743 or higher is proving challenging!
